name: Kuala Lumpur
summary: The rail lines of Kuala Lumpur (KTM Komuter, LRT, MRT, KL Monorail, ERL) inside the Federal Territory, with the signature spots on them.
notes: The box around the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur (OSM boundary relation 2939672: 3.0334–3.2446 N, 101.6151–101.7585 E) plus a small margin. It is cut out of the Klang Valley fetch (regions/klang-valley/raw/), so a wider region needs no new download. Lines are cut where they leave the box for good.
